title: Materials & Stock
headline: Know what was bought, used and moved.
subhead: Item names are standardised, so 'cement' and 'Cement ' are never tracked as two different things.
description: Stock moves with accountability. Low-stock alerts reach you and your site managers before work halts.

steps.title: Bought
steps.text: Purchases carry the bill and the vendor. Once you verify, stock and site cost update together.

steps.title: Used
steps.text: Site teams log what was used, so what's left is a record, not a guess.

steps.title: Moved
steps.text: Transfers between sites need approval, and the stock's value moves with it.

steps.title: Never Surprised
steps.text: Set a reorder level per item. Low-stock alerts reach you and the site's managers.
